designationHistory.indexText: Fish Springs National Wildlife Refuge in Utah's west desert was established in 1959 with approval of the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission, as an inviolate sanctuary for migratory birds.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval (Migratory Bird Conservation Act)

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Comprehensive Conservation Plan: Fish Springs NWR, 2004 (ServCat 1423)

designationHistory.indexText: The Interior Department withdrew public land in Utah for the Fish Springs National Wildlife Refuge under Public Land Order 1942.
designationHistory.note: The order is dated August 12, 1959 and signed by an Assistant Secretary of the Interior (Federal Register). It added public land to the refuge; Public Land Order 2563 (December 22, 1961) added more (CCP).
